draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.00, the 138th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 9th of 14 at guard. He went 144th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Nate Herbig. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Tennessee Titans. 23 career games and 7 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 1 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 1 AV in 2025 against a career-best 2 in 2023. Weak spots: approximate value 1 (9th percentile). Played 3 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-3 guard who played: 15.3% season snap share against a median of 40.7%, below the norm.
